synopsis: Boreal3D is described as an environment-creation tool providing synthetic forest lidar plots through procedural generation [f16005, f15956, f3732]. It contains 1,000 synthetic plots simulated across four laser-scanning platforms: airborne, unmanned, mobile and terrestrial [f4150, f3840]. Its physics-based lidar provides exact structural ground truth, and the booklet cites its forestry work as off-road evidence for statistically matched digital cousins [f4151, f4277]. The preprint dates to January 2025, followed by publication in Remote Sensing of Environment, volume 341, in August 2026 [f4152, f4153]. The glossary groups Boreal3D with CropCraft and AgriGen as supporting agricultural and forest scenes, while the Boreal3D-specific facts describe forest plots [f16086, f16005, f15956].
